sentences.text: Today we will talk about Cambodia.
Cambodia is a beautiful, historic, and peaceful country in Southeast Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Cambodia?
Cambodia is in Southeast Asia.
It is next to Thailand, Laos, and Vietnam.
To the south, it touches the Gulf of Thailand.
It has rivers, lakes, forests, and temples.
What is the capital city of Cambodia?
The capital city is Phnom Penh.
It is the largest city in Cambodia.
It has palaces, markets, museums, and the Mekong River.
Other cities include Siam Reap, near the famous Angkor Wat temple, Phatom Bang, known for farming and art, Siamakville, a beach city by the sea.
How many people live in Cambodia?
About 17 million people live in Cambodia.
Many people live in the countryside, but cities are growing.
The people are called Cambodians, and they are known for being kind and welcoming.
What language do people speak in Cambodia?
People speak Khmer, pronounced Khmai.
It is the official language.
Some people also speak English or French, especially in cities and schools.
What is the weather like in Cambodia?
Cambodia has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid most of the year.
There are two seasons, rainy season from May to October, dry season from November to April.
The weather is warm all year, so people wear light clothes.
What does Cambodia look like?
Cambodia has the Mekong River, one of the longest in Asia, rice fields and palm trees, forests, mountains and temples, beaches in the South, Tonle Sap Lake, the largest lake in Southeast Asia.
It is a land of nature, history and tradition.
What animals live in Cambodia?
In Cambodia you may see elephants, deer and monkeys, crocodiles, snakes and lizards, birds like herons and hornbills, cows, chickens and ducks and villages.
Some people ride ox carts or keep buffalo for farming.
What do people eat in Cambodia?
Cambodian food is mild, fresh and delicious.
People eat rice with every meal.
Fish, especially from the lake or river, vegetables, herbs and noodles.

Popular dishes, amok, fish with coconut and spices and banana leaves, lak lak, stir -fried beef with sauce, bay sash crook, rice with grilled pork, numban chak, rice noodles with curry, fried insects like crickets or spiders in some places.
What do people drink in Cambodia?
Cambodia, people drink water and coconut water, iced tea and sugar cane juice, fruit shakes, mango, banana or dragon fruit.
Adults may drink beer or rice wine.
Cold drinks are popular because of the heat.
What is life like in Cambodia?
Life in Cambodia is simple and community based.
People enjoy spending time with family, visiting temples, going to markets, riding motorbikes, celebrating festivals.
Many people work in farming, textiles or tourism.
What are some holidays and traditions in Cambodia?
Khmer New Year in April with water and games.
Pi Chum Ben to honor ancestors.
Water Festival Bon Om Tuk, boat races on the River Independence Day, November 9th.
Visak Boche, Buddhist holiday for Buddha's birth.
Most people in Cambodia are Buddhist and visit pagodas to pray.
Some fun facts about Cambodia.
The Khmer Empire built Angkor Wat, the largest temple in the world.
The Cambodian flag is the only flag with a building, Angkor Wat on it.
Many houses and villages are built on stilts.
Cambodia has one of the youngest populations in the world.
Traditional music includes gongs, flutes and dancing.
Now you know many things about Cambodia.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about temples, nature and holidays.
Great job!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
